get_world_context: get the current world context from the global world stack or return None if empty
use_baseworld_context_manager: use a BaseWorld subclass as a context manager to push and pop from the world stack
call_rv_identifier: call a random variable node via BaseWorld.call to invoke its wrapper with arguments
update_graph_abstract: implement the abstract update_graph method in a BaseWorld subclass to update the probabilistic graph
nest_world_contexts: nest multiple BaseWorld contexts to manage layered world state on the world stack
